card.capacity_status_quote: We're working with our suppliers, but the lead times are long, and there is tension on the back end.
card.demand_direction_quote: We do see demand continue to grow for standard servers, which is good for us with agentic AI in particular. We expect the server market to grow faster this year than last year.
card.guidance_direction_quote: So we don't see the situation as materially different than what we saw in Q1.
card.constraint_owner_quote: But as we said last quarter, we're watching the situation with supply, especially on the back end. Certainly, since last quarter, the situation has not improved.
